attributes.board_name: Mississippi State Board of Dental Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses approved by ADA, AGD, Mississippi Dental Association, Mississippi Dental Society, NDA, NDHA, MDHA, ADHA, AADB or the Mississippi State Board of Medical Licensure, or approved by the Board course by course; BLS/ACLS/PALS hours count (caps 8/16/16)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt during the first biennial renewal period.
rules.audit_note: Licensee certifies compliance at renewal and uploads proof to the CE tracking system (CE Broker); random audit after each period; keep records 3 years. Fines from $500 (first offense).
rules.notes: Period Jan 1 of odd year to Dec 31 of even year. Online/correspondence courses allowed if they include a post-study exam. Current CPR certification (AHA, Red Cross, ACLS or PALS with hands-on component) required under Board Regulation 45.
rules.legal_basis: 30 Miss. Admin. Code Pt. 2301, R. 1.41 (Board Regulation 41)

topics.who: Current CPR (AHA, Red Cross, ACLS or PALS with hands-on component)
